SaveInArtifex.description: Save generated images in Artifex. Right-click a preview to delete that image from the library.

group.name: Group
group.tooltip: Target group; also the fallback when the connected group name cannot be used.

color_group.name: Color group
color_group.tooltip: Optional. None uploads without assigning a color group.

auto_tag.name: Auto-tag
auto_tag.tooltip: Ask Artifex to automatically tag uploaded images.

group_name.name: Group name
group_name.tooltip: Overrides the group selection. Creates missing groups and uses the most populated match for duplicate names.

color_group_name.name: Color group name
color_group_name.tooltip: Overrides the color group selection. Creates missing color groups and uses the most populated match for duplicate names.
